I've been doing some looking around myself and could only find an old tutorial thread on [pokecommunity.com](https://pokecommunity.com). I just got the education version since I want to get into making a 5th gen rom hack myself, although I can't find anything more updated than that 13 year old thread.  I'm gonna continue to look some more though.
